title: Raid plan templates
intro: A template lays out the coarse plan without players: slots for tanks, healers and DPS, groups, raid marks, zones and task rows per boss. When an event's raid plan is made you pick one, and its slots are filled from the approved setup.
serverHint: With a server the template only shows for events on that server.
conflict: The template was changed in the meantime. Your changes are still here, but you can only save after reloading.
deleteText: Raid plans that already used it keep their copy. The template's maps are deleted.
editorHint: There are no players here: slots (Tank 1, Healer 1 …) are filled from the event's setup when the template is applied.
